simple.meaning: אָבָה (ʼâbâh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to breathe after, i.e. (figuratively) to be acquiescent.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 54 times across Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Deuteronomy, Joshua, and 12 more, beginning at Genesis 24:5. Its contexts include family line, commandment, kingship, land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אָבָה (H14).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: אָבָה (ʼâbâh) / H14 is traced through Genesis 24:5, Genesis 24:8, Exodus 10:27, Leviticus 26:21 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.short: to breathe after, i.e. (figuratively) to be acquiescent
definitions.usage: consent, rest content will, be willing.
definitions.full: H14. abah I. אָבָה verb be willing, consent (compare Assyrian abîtu , command , Dl W , Ethiopic refuse , Arabic , id., Nejd be willing So De Jes 3, p. 26; LCB 1880, 817 ) — Qal (with אַל לֹא, except Isa 1:19 ; Job 39:9 ; in Hexateuch rare & only J E D, including Lev 26:21 ); Perfect אָבָה Exod 10:27 + אָבוּ Judg 19:25 7 t.; אָבוּא Isa 28:12 (Sta § 31 R. 2 ; Kö 1, 414 ); Imperfect יֹאבֶה Deut 29:19 2 t.; 2 masculine singular jussive תֹּבֵא Prov 1:10 (Sta § 143 e 1 fin ; Kö 1, 576 f ) etc.; Participle אֹבִים Ezek 3:7 ; — be willing , followed by Infinitive with ל Exod 10:27 29 t.; without ל Deut 2:30 8 t.; subject ׳י 10:10 ; 23:6 ; 29:19 ; Josh 24:10 ; 2Kin 8:19 ; 13:23 ; 24:4 ; 2Chr 21:7 ; human subject Gen 24:5 , 8 ; Judg 19:10 ; 2Sam 2:21 ; 13:25 ; 14:29 (twice in verse); 23:16-17 , = 1Chr 11:18-19 , 19:19 ; in bad sense Exod 10:27 ; Deut 2:30 ; 25:7 ; Judg 19:25 ; 20:13 ; 2Sam 13:14 , 16 ; especially of perverse Israel Lev 26:21 ; Deut 1:26 ; 1Sam 15:9 ; Isa 28:12 ; 30:9 ; 42:24 ; Ezek 3:7 (twice in verse); 20:8 ; subject animal, רֵים Job 39:9 ; absolute (no Infinitive) 2Sam 12:17 ; 1Kin 20:8 ; 22:50 ; compare Prov 6:35 , of jealous man; bad sense Judg 11:17 ; Isa 30:15 ; good sense 1Sam 22:17 ; 26:23 ; 31:4 = 1Chr 10:4 ; 2Sam 6:10 ; Prov 1:10 ; + finite verb Isa 1:19 ( וּשְׁמַעְתֶּם תּאֹבוּ אִם ); consent, yield to , followed by לוֺ Deut 13:9 (good sense); followed by לִי Psa 81:12 ; followed by לַעֲצָתִי Prov 1:30 ; followed by accusative תּוֺכַחְתִּי 1:25 (all in bad sense).
